mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, we are looking at clear skies and 59 degrees near Verona City Hall under a waxing crescent moon.

The City of Verona has announced that road work begins August 18 on Highway M, which will shift traffic patterns for the next few weeks, and the Senior Center is currently recruiting volunteers for various local programs.
Today, Epic Systems hosts the User Group Meeting, and tomorrow you can test your knowledge at trivia nights at both Hop Haus Brewing Company and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In police news from August 5, officers located a man on Whalen Road and took him into custody after he attempted to flee from a probation violation warrant.

Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. Since the store is currently closed, you can plan your visit for when they open at 10 AM. Tomorrow's featured flavor will be Caramel Chocolate Pecan.
